entries.title: Job 32:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Elihu is angry with Job and his three friends. 6 Because wisdom comes not from age, he excuses the boldness of his youth. 11 He reproves them for not satisfying Job. 16 His zeal to speak.

to answer. Heb. from answering. righteous. 6:29; 10:2,7; 13:15; 23:7; 27:4-6; 29:11-17; 31:1-40; 33:9

entries.title: Job 32:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: kindled. Ps 69:9; Mr 3:5; Eph 4:26 Buzite. Ge 22:21 because. 10:3; 27:2; 34:5,6,17,18; 35:2; 40:8; Lu 10:29 himself. Heb. his soul.

entries.title: Job 32:4
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: waited till Job had spoken. Heb. expected Job in words. 11,12; Pr 18:13 elder. Heb. elder for days.

entries.title: Job 32:5
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: his wrath. 2; Ex 32:19

entries.title: Job 32:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I am. Le 19:32; Ro 13:7; 1Ti 5:1; Tit 2:6; 1Pe 5:5 young. Heb. few of days. ye are. 15:10 durst not. Heb. feared. 15:7; 1Sa 17:28-30

entries.title: Job 32:11
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
I waited for. 4; 29:21,23 reasons. Heb. understandings.Instead of {tevoonotheychem,} nine MSS. read {techoonotheychem,} "your arguments;" but the sense is nearly the same.

whilst.{Ad tachkeroon millin,} "whilst ye were searching for words;" a fine irony, which they must have felt.

5:27; Pr 18:17; 28:11; Ec 12:9,10 what to say. Heb. words.

entries.title: Job 32:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
unto you.{We�deychem} is rendered "and your testimonies," by the Syriac, Arabic, and LXX., and one of De Rossi's Mss. (874) is so pointed as to require this reading.

behold. 3; 1Ti 1:7

entries.title: Job 32:14
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: directed. Heb. ordered.

entries.title: Job 32:15
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: amazed. 6:24,25; 29:22; Mt 7:23; 22:22,26,34,46 left off speaking. Heb. removed speeches from themselves.

entries.title: Job 32:18
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: matter. Heb. words. the spirit. Ps 39:3; Jer 20:9; Eze 3:14-27; Ac 4:20; 2Co 5:13,14 within me. Heb. of my belly.

entries.title: Job 32:19
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: hath no vent. Heb. is not opened. new. Mt 9:17

entries.title: Job 32:20
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I will speak. 13:13,19; 20:2; 21:3 be refreshed. Heb. breathe. I will open. Pr 8:6,7

entries.title: Job 32:22
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: I know not. That is, I cannot. 17:5; Ps 12:2,3; Pr 29:5; 1Th 2:5; Ga 1:10
